headline: NCLT Chennai Passes First Motion Order in MPS–ADI BPO Amalgamation Scheme
sum: MPS Limited received the First Motion Order from NCLT Chennai in the proposed amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited into MPS Limited. The order marks the initial judicial approval stage in the scheme, with further statutory and shareholder approvals pending.
detail: MPS Limited, a listed IT/BPO services company, filed a Scheme of Amalgamation proposing to merge ADI BPO Services Limited into itself. The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench, has granted the First Motion Order (sometimes called 'Preliminary Order'), a critical procedural milestone that permits the company to convene shareholder meetings and creditor meetings to vote on the scheme. Subsequent to securing the requisite majority votes, the parties must return to NCLT for the Final Order and then seek the Central Government's confirmation. The amalgamation is expected to consolidate BPO/IT service delivery and operational footprint.
